purpose: Labelled replies for measuring the reply guardrails in both directions: good replies that must not be blocked (false rejections) and bad replies that must be blocked (false approvals). Policy evidence is given as chunk ids from the Markdown corpus, so the checks see real policy text. Cases marked 'paraphrase' word an unsupported promise in a way no phrase list anticipates; the rules alone may miss them, and the model-based commitment check (--live) is measured on them.

cases.reply: We're sorry your furniture arrived late. A refund of ₹749.75 has been issued to your original payment method.

cases.reply: Electronics can be returned within 15 calendar days of the delivery date.
